title: Heavy live loads.
officialText:
Live loads that exceed 100 psf (4.79 kN/m2) shall not be reduced.
Exceptions:
1. The live loads for members supporting two or more floors are permitted to be reduced by a maximum of
20 percent, but the live load shall not be less than L as calculated in Section 1607.9.1.
2. For uses other than storage, where approved, additional live load reductions shall be permitted where
shown by the registered design professional that a rational approach has been used and that such
reductions are warranted.
